channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Shapiro Clashes With RFK Jr. After Pennsylvania Measles Deaths
item.description: Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro blamed US Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. for sowing distrust in vaccines as the state confronts a widening measles outbreak that has killed two people and infected hundreds of others.

item.title: World News Today Live Updates on August 27, 2026 : Netanyahu rules out diplomacy with Iran's ‘savages’, backs Trump’s economic pressure campaign
item.description: World News Today Live Updates on August 27, 2026: Stay informed on global events with our in-depth world news coverage, bringing you the latest developments across politics, economy, and culture. Discover insights into international affairs, breaking news, and the trends shaping our interconnected world, all in one place.

item.title: Netanyahu rules out diplomacy with Iran's ‘savages’, backs Trump’s economic pressure campaign
item.description: Netanyahu said he doubted that negotiations could produce an agreement with Iran’s current leadership.

item.title: Trump says Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei is alive but ‘very seriously wounded’
item.description: Mojtaba Khamenei was appointed Iran’s supreme leader after his father, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, was killed during US-Israeli strikes on Iran on February 28. The younger Khamenei was reportedly wounded in the same attacks and has not appeared publicly since becoming supreme leader.

item.title: US Army faces leadership vacuum as Hegseth firings leave top ranks depleted: Report
item.description: A series of dismissals and internal disputes under Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has left several senior Army positions vacant or in temporary hands.

item.title: Mumbai woman quits corporate job, retires at 29 to slow life in Pune farm, here's how she did it
item.description: A woman who shifted from Mumbai to Pune to live a farm life, shared steps to secure an early retirement in life. She currently runs BaapBeti Farms with her father.

item.title: Swine flu in Delhi: H1N1 cases climb past 2,400; Health min holds review meeting with govt hospitals: Top 10 updates
item.description: Delhi reported 138 new H1N1 cases, totaling 2,446 this year. Health Minister Pankaj Singh emphasised that patients generally show mild symptoms and there’s ‘no need for panic’, ensuring readiness for increased cases.

item.title: Sugar supply crunch? Swiggy Instamart, Blinkit restrict purchases ahead of festive season, says report
item.description: The recent rise in sugar prices has been linked to production falling below earlier estimates, exports of 800,000 tonnes and alleged stockpiling by some trade intermediaries.

item.title: Quote of the day by William Faulkner: 'The past is never dead. It's not even….'
item.description: William Faulkner's quote emphasises that the past remains influential in shaping the present. Memories and experiences linger, affecting individuals and societies, highlighting the importance of acknowledging history to understand current challenges and avoid repeating mistakes.

item.title: Was Kid Rock helicopter probe behind US Army chief Randy George’s ouster? What report says
item.description: Hegseth removed George as Army chief of staff without publicly providing a reason. George had been expected to remain in the position until fall 2027, completing what would normally have been a four-year term.

item.title: One dependent visa, 12 restaurants: The Indian entrepreneur who built a new life in US
item.description: The woman who shifted from India to the US opened up about her journey of 25 years and how she found her purpose in life after some ‘soul searching.’ Her story has received a warm response from the internet.

item.title: Onion supply comfortable for the coming months, says consumer affairs secretary
item.description: The government has started moving buffer-stock onions through railway and road transport. The move comes ahead of the festival and wedding season.

item.title: Family ‘opens cafeteria’ on flight: Viral video leaves social media divided, ‘Indians and their habit of…’
item.description: A viral video shows ‘North Indian’ passengers treating a flight like a cafeteria, causing debate on cultural habits and their impact on fellow travellers. While some criticise the strong food odours, others defend their right to eat as they please and challenge cultural assumptions.

item.title: People risk lives to retrieve LPG cylinders from debris amid Nepal flash floods, video goes viral | Watch
item.description: Rescue efforts are currently underway in Nepal as rescuers are wading through mud and sludge to look for survivors in the floods. Amid this, mostly men were spotted collecting LPG cylinders from the debris.&nbsp;

item.title: From KitKat to Maggi: Investigation reveals global food brands use different recipes in India
item.description: Nestlé's Indian KitKat contains 4.5% cocoa, contrasting with Australia's 22%, according to a Reuters report, adding that Indian Maggi noodles use palm oil, unlike pricier sunflower oil in the UK. Health activists say many Indian consumers believe they are being offered lower-quality products.

item.title: Nepal flash flood: Wall of water tears through Himalayan villages; terrifying videos surface
item.description: Footage released by Nepal Police and circulated widely on social media captured powerful currents of muddy floodwater surging through valleys in the country's Himalayan districts near the Tibet border.

item.title: Railways to quadruple capacity across 11,000 km of key routes carrying 41% of traffic
item.description: This initiative supports logistics cost reduction and economic growth while minimizing environmental impact, fulfilling the government's transport strategy.

item.title: US Open 2026 tickets at $100: Mamdani announces discounted offer for New Yorkers; Check how to get them
item.description: For New Yorkers hoping to attend the 2026 US Open, the key detail is timing: the 1,000 discounted tickets go on sale at 10 a.m. on August 26, with a limit of two $100 tickets per resident and availability on a first-come, first-served basis.

item.title: US disrupts Chinese hacking operation targeting NASA, Federal Reserve, Senate and other agencies
item.description: The Justice Department said it had seized domains linked to two hacking platforms, known as “QScan” and “QTRouter,” which were allegedly used in the cyber campaign.

item.title: Nepal flash floods trigger Gandak alert in Bihar; several districts at risk
item.description: The districts facing the most immediate risk in Bihar include West Champaran, East Champaran, Gopalganj and Saran, which are directly or closely connected to the Gandak river system. Authorities have also placed Muzaffarpur and Vaishali under heightened vigilance.

item.title: Iran, Oman strike Hormuz revenue deal; Tehran warns US must meet demands to reopen waterway
item.description: Despite the progress with Oman, Iran said the agreement is being delayed because of US opposition. Mohebi accused Washington of obstructing the process and warned that Iran would not reopen the waterway unless the United States accepts Tehran's demands.

item.title: Cockroaches, rotten food, ‘gutka’ packet: FSSAI issues notices to JW Marriott, Andaz Aerocity Delhi
item.description: FSSAI has issued notices to 5-star hotels JW Marriott and Andaz over hygiene issues and cockroaches on the premises.

item.title: India, Japan seek deeper startup, deep-tech cooperation; Goyal pitches $1 billion fund and capital corridor
item.description: India and Japan are formalizing a deep-tech alliance through a proposed four-pillar framework, backed by a planned $1 billion Indian fund of funds. The initiative leverages India's scaling talent and Japan's capital and manufacturing expertise to build long-term supply chain partnerships.

item.title: Nepal flash floods: Did earthquakes trigger the avalanche that left at least 22 dead and hundreds missing?
item.description: At least 22 people were killed and hundreds are feared missing after an avalanche of ice and rock triggered massive flash floods in Nepal. Rasuwa and Dhading districts have been the worst hit by the flood.

item.title: Meta agrees to $16.68 billion settlement with 29 US states over child data collection, teen ‘addiction by design’
item.description: Meta Platforms has settled claims from US states, accused of creating Instagram and Facebook to foster children’s dependence and misleading users about safety. This agreement concluded a significant federal trial concerning social media's impact on minors.

item.title: Elon Musk gets Ukraine’s top honour as Zelensky pushes for Starlink access over Russian territory
item.description: The honour recognises his contribution to protecting human life and freedom and to strengthening relations between Ukraine and the United States.

item.title: Denmark, India deepen maritime ties, eye shipbuilding and naval technology collaboration
item.description: The two countries are working on a feasibility study to identify opportunities in naval and commercial shipbuilding, followed by a targeted programme to deepen Danish companies' presence in the Indian market.

item.title: Thousands are pulling a 400-tonne castle in Japan with ropes — but why?
item.description: Local authorities estimate that roughly 4,000 people, including participants from overseas, have taken part in the operation so far.

item.title: Job postings rose 1.2% in July after three-month decline, but new study flags IT hiring slowdown
item.description: India’s job market is showing signs of recovery, with job postings rising in July after three months of decline. But the latest data reveals a shift in where hiring demand is building—and where it is weakening. AI is also changing what employers look for.

item.title: Nepal Flash Floods Live Updates: PM Balendra Shah urges nation to ‘stand together’ as 95 killed, 105 Indians missing
item.description: Nepal Flash Floods Live Updates: A total of 95 people have been killed, according to police in Nepal. Nepal PM Balendra Shah urged nation to 'stand together' after deadly flood. Meanwhile, the Bihar administration has started evacuating residents from six districts.

item.title: Heavy rain to lash north, central India; flash flood risk in several districts
item.description: Bharatpur, Dholpur and Karauli districts in east Rajasthan may face flash flood risk. In west Uttar Pradesh, districts including Agra, Aligarh, Auraiya, Badaun, Etah, Firozabad, Hamirpur, Jhansi, Kasganj, Mainpuri, Mathura and Shahjahanpur are at risk.

item.title: India’s engineering exports jump 18% to $12.24 billion in July; US remains top market
item.description: Strong gains in key markets like the US and China kept monthly shipments above $10 billion, though trade body EEPC India warned that geopolitical friction and rising non-tariff barriers pose headwinds.

item.title: ₹5.74 lakh bill for 10 days of luxury stay: Delhi family flees Udaipur hotel without clearing dues, FIR lodged
item.description: A family of four reportedly spent 10 days at The Oberoi Udaivilas Hotel in Udaipur, availing luxury facilities and services before leaving on 25 August. According to the hotel authorities, the family claimed that a travel agency would settle their invoice before vanishing from the property.

item.title: Piyush Goyal highlights India's startup growth during Japan visit as count nears to '250000': ‘Great companies aren’t…'
item.description: Union Minister Piyush Goyal emphasised India's expanding startup ecosystem, growing from 400-500 startups a decade ago to nearly 250,000 today. He urged a generational focus for successful companies and highlighted ongoing cooperation with Japan in financial services and industries during his visit.

item.title: US threatens Iran’s trade partners with sanctions: Who are Tehran’s biggest economic partners? Will it affect India?
item.description: The countries who are likely to be affected are China, Turkey, the UAE, Iraq, the European Union, India, Pakistan, as well as Russia.
